reviews.text:
DFW Retaining Walls provide great service and great value.  Nathan and his crew were easy to work with and did a superior job of replacing a retaining wall. The attention to detail and the overall look is outstanding. The crew went above expectations in making the existing fence blend seamlessly with the new wall.

I highly recommend Nathan and DFW Retaining Walls.
reviews.author: T Bielefeldt

reviews.text:
Our experience from our first visit with Nathan, till the completion date was nothing but stellar.  Each crew was professional, took pride in their work and cleaned up the work areas.  It was a large pool demo and it went so smooth…I have never had a project this big go as great as this did and it is ALL DUE TO NATHAN…he cares and it shows.
We had our pool removed and the hot tub was made into usable patio space. Before during and after photos included
reviews.author: Lori White

reviews.text: The absolutely best company we’ve ever worked with, hands down! Nathan Rodriguez and his team took care of us from day one. Reasonable quote, exceptional communication and expertise, the most hard-working and professional team of laborers we’ve experienced in literally every trade we’ve come across. Had an existing Pavestone wall and wrought iron fence removed by them and a new Milsap stone gravity retaining wall built to replace. The level of cleanup, attention to detail, thoughtful and excellent work ethic of all involved. I can’t, simply can’t, shout their accolades loud enough. Highly recommend them and would do it again!!
reviews.author: Kristen Piwetz

reviews.text: DFW Retaining Walls was hands down the best contractor to get the job done to install a new retaining wall and fence above a concrete drainage ditch in my back yard. Most notably, they came through with a fair bid to do the job compared to 4 other contractors in the DFW area that was above my price range. Nathan and his team were very professional and communicative. There was a long wait time before they were able to start the job but it was well worth the wait. My previous retaining wall and fence had failed and was near washing out with all these rains we've been getting. Nathan's team put in the much needed work and completed the job quicker than I was expecting. I never expected my new retaining wall to look as beautiful as it does. Because they did such a great job, I'm hoping to use their services again in the very near future. If you're looking to have your retaining wall redone, DFW retaining walls is the company to go with.
reviews.author: Sharp Scans

reviews.text: I am very pleased!  From the beginning of the first appointment I was impressed.  I had interviewed 4 other companies and didn't see same professionalism.  Nathan Rodriguez and his crew were wonderful. We ran into MANY delays due to rain and Nathan kept me informed for the duration. I was worried because I had an overseas trip I couldn't postpone but due to the trust I had with Nathan I left and he completed project!  It was done better than I even expected!  I couldn't be happier!  I am providing before and after photos
reviews.author: Joni Jacobs

reviews.text: We have always heard that good things come to those who wait.  This saying is true for DFW Retaining Walls & Pool Demolition.  Because of the heavy spring rains in the DFW area, we had to be placed in line waiting for our retaining wall to be built.  From start to finish, Nathan and his team were fantastic.  Nathan explained everything and kept us in the loop for a time frame on when construction would begin to when it would be completed.  As our wall was being built, our yard was kept tidy and the crew building our wall was extremely courteous.  They always let us know when they were going to lunch or taking a break so that we could let our dogs out for a break.  Clean-up after the wall was completed was impeccable! Every bit of sand, rock and cement mixture was gone and our driveway was power washed.  Our new retaining wall is even better than we thought it could be.  Our yard has been completely transformed.  Without a doubt, we would HIGHLY recommend using DFW Retaining Walls & Pool Demolition and would definitely use them again in the future if needed.
reviews.author: Laura Ledbetter

reviews.text: Nathan and his team did an outstanding job on my retaining wall. The workers were on time every day and worked diligently to get the job done. They also cleaned up nicely afterwards! Nathan is extremely professional and knowledgeable and I would definitely recommend him without hesitation!
reviews.author: Luanne Choppy

reviews.text:
It was time to replace the collapsing railroad ties at the property line and I couldn't be more pleased with the Millsap Stone retaining wall placed by Nathan's crew!

Nathan was prompt, professional, and thorough in answering questions and educating about the process. The crew was quick and efficient and the final product a lovely enhancement to the property.

I've been getting many compliments from neighbors and have no hesitation in giving Nathan and DFW Retaining Walls five stars!
reviews.author: Victoria Johnson
